title: Transport of the counit stalk condition from localized cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, and $g':X'\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] forming a cartesian square [def-pc-base-change]. Let $G$ be any cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and write $\epsilon_{g'}(G):L(g')^*Q(G)\to Q((g')^*G)$ for the universal derived-to-ordinary pullback counit [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. At $z\in X'$ set $R=\mathcal O_{S,f(g'z)}$, $A=\mathcal O_{X,g'z}$, $B=\mathcal O_{S',f'z}$, and $C=\mathcal O_{X',z}$ with the actual stalk-map algebra structures [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Suppose for every $z$ and $i\in\mathbb Z$ the localized comparison of the canonical model [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for $G_{g'z}$, from $H^i(G_{g'z}\otimes_R^L B)\otimes_{A\otimes_R B}C$ to $H^i(G_{g'z}\otimes_A C)$, is an isomorphism. Then $\epsilon_{g'}(G)$ satisfies the coordinate-independent stalk condition [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]: the displayed stalkComparison is invertible in every degree and at every point for every K-flat coordinate system of this counit.

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution s:P to G. Its quasi-isomorphism gives e = asIso(Q.map s). Put N = tensorPullback(g') G, take e' to be the identity, and t = tensorPullback(g') s. The universal derived-pullback counit is invertible on P: transport the K-flat counit supplied by exists_derivedPullback along the unique isomorphism to the counit of exists_derivedPullbackComposition. Naturality of this counit proves the represents equation, so these data define coordinates c.

For z,i apply the quasi-isomorphism square to s. Unfolding stalkComparison c identifies it with the left side of the square. Its right side is e.hom followed by localizedComparison G followed by the homology of tensorStalkIso G. The first and last factors are isomorphisms and the middle factor is invertible by h z i, so stalkComparison c is invertible.
For arbitrary coordinates d, coordinate invariance transfers the invertibility in c to d at the same z,i. Quantifying over d,z,i proves StalkCondition.

theorem counit_stalkCondition_of_localizedComparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (h : ∀ z : X',
      letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
      letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
      letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (R f g' z))
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B f' z))
      ∀ i : ℤ, IsIso ((cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq z G).localizedComparison i)) :
    StalkCondition f f' g g' sq (DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj G))
      ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj G))
